There's a lot of games like this, and this one a mix of free/unfinished. Some differences I've seen, there's no hit collision unless it happens to be the monster's style of attacking. There's constantly a mix of random events, things that can customise builds for both focused and diverse. Also the roguelike aspect of small power gains between tries has a much larger pool of stuff than other things I've played. And the cost goes up each time you buy something to get more things. That means your choices are meaningful rather than a grind to have everything. I liked it overall, but a bit too hard for me to do more than I have. Even my best tries didn't pass grasslands 5 or hell 3.

Undeniably, the art needs polish, be it visually or the audio. However, the mechanics of the game are as solid as can be. Enticing, challenging, and entertaining, this game will have you coming back and playing again and again, to reach new stages, to gain new equipment, to unlock new perks... Does a lot better than many other games of the same genre. And icing on the cake, it's free ! Give it a try. Don't blame me if you get hooked.

Elewar is the best survivors-like I've ever played. I didn't really like Vampire Survivors, but this game is much deeper and decision-based. You can get very strong by figuring out how certain mechanics work, and it's really easy to learn how to play. The developer is great and has been releasing at least 1 patch nearly every day. Game didn't used to work well on Steam Deck, but it works nearly flawlessly now. If you've liked any survivors-like you've played, I can promise this one will be worth your time. Also it's free. So try it.

this game was fun up to a point where it was nearly impossible due to the whole screen filled with damaging effects/areas. There is no defense, except to try to avoid, there is no "dodge/dash/evade" mechanic in the game <that I saw> I play a lot of bullet hell/heaven games, I get that they are supposed to be "challenging", but when the game makes it too "challenging" it becomes not fun. I've ran into this same issue with other games in this genre. The game could maybe add an iframe mechanic, or invulnerability for short time when you get hit.

One of the best Vamp-clones out there! And it's free?!?! The classes and skills are awesome, the mechanics are good and fun, the closed maps feel refreshing. It starts a bit slow, and you have to unlock LOTS of stuff to get things going, but after 20+ hours I just want to play even more and unlock more stuff, or try different combos.

I have played many horde survival/vampire survivors/bullet heaven games. I play nearly every one, and this one is free...and very very well done. progression is well paced, better then most paid games. Just to be clear, this game isn't free to play, its actually free. No microtransations.

Don't be turned off by the presentation - sure this game is not a looker, but it's very competent at all things required to be a great survivor. Meta progression done right, plenty of classes and relics to create a plethora of builds, stuff to do on the battlefield, interesting item crafting system. Things I'd love to see improved are spell upgrade system and utility spells, so hopefully it's not the end state. I would go as far as to say that it would be fair to charge money for product.

I love all the different spell combos and fusions you can do, as well as the variety of upgrades in game that are available. Also all the nerds who are crying about it being too hard literally just played 1 or 2 games and rage quit cuz they couldnt win. It took me an hour or 2 of game play to finish my first run. I kept dying on the 5 minute mark at first, then I bought some upgrades, then I reached the 12 minute, bought some upgrades and finally I was able to do 20 minutes.
